union all
select 'query_generation' as "table", min("index") as first, max("index") as latest, extract(epoch from now() - max("index")) as age, approximate_row_count('"entsoe"."query_generation"'::regclass) as "rows (approx)" from "entsoe"."query_generation"
union all
select 'query_generation_forecast' as "table", min("index") as first, max("index") as latest, extract(epoch from now() - max("index")) as age, approximate_row_count('"entsoe"."query_generation_forecast"'::regclass) as "rows (approx)" from "entsoe"."query_generation_forecast"
union all
select 'query_wind_and_solar_forecast' as "table", min("index") as first, max("index") as latest, extract(epoch from now() - max("index")) as age, approximate_row_count('"entsoe"."query_wind_and_solar_forecast"'::regclass) as "rows (approx)" from "entsoe"."query_wind_and_solar_forecast"
union all
select 'query_day_ahead_prices' as "table", min("index") as first, max("index") as latest, extract(epoch from now() - max("index")) as age, approximate_row_count('"entsoe"."query_day_ahead_prices"'::regclass) as "rows (approx)" from "entsoe"."query_day_ahead_prices"
union all

select 'query_installed_generation_capacity' as "table", min("index") as first, max("index") as latest, extract(epoch from now() - max("index")) as age, approximate_row_count('"entsoe"."query_installed_generation_capacity"'::regclass) as "rows (approx)" from "entsoe"."query_installed_generation_capacity"

panels.description: First and latest timestamp per table, age of the latest value (green < 48 h, orange < 168 h, red older) and approximate row count (TimescaleDB approximate_row_count).

options.content:
**ENTSO-E Transparency Platform** (crawler `entsoe`, schema `entsoe`). Instants are `timestamptz` (UTC), values in MW unless stated.
Generation is *netted* (`nett=True`: pumped-storage consumption shows as negative). Resolution is hourly for older years and 15 min since Oct 2025.
Several zones exist twice in the data (e.g. `DE`, `DE_LU`, `DE_AMPRION` ...); do not add them up. `GB` data ends in 2021, newer values are filed under `UK`.
The installed capacity is published once per year (index = 1 Jan).

panels.title: Load in Europe (sum of 15 large zones)

targets.rawSql:
select time, sum(v) as "actual load" from (select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), country, avg(actual_load) v from entsoe.query_load
where $__timeFilter(index) and country in ('DE_LU','AT','BE','CH','CZ','DK','ES','FR','HU','IT','NL','PL','PT','SE','NO') group by 1,2) t group by 1 order by 1

select time, sum(v) as "day-ahead forecast" from (select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), country, avg(forecasted_load) v from entsoe.query_load_forecast
where $__timeFilter(index) and country in ('DE_LU','AT','BE','CH','CZ','DK','ES','FR','HU','IT','NL','PL','PT','SE','NO') group by 1,2) t group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Sum of the average actual load and the day-ahead load forecast over the zones DE_LU,AT,BE,CH,CZ,DK,ES,FR,HU,IT,NL,PL,PT,SE,NO. Zones with missing values lower the sum for that interval.

panels.title: Generation in Europe by technology group (same zones)

targets.rawSql:
select time, sum(nuclear) as nuclear, sum(fossil) as fossil, sum(hydro) as hydro, sum(wind) as wind, sum(solar) as solar, sum(other_res) as "biomass & other" from (
select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), country,
 avg(nuclear) nuclear,
 avg(coalesce("fossil_brown_coal/lignite",0)+coalesce(fossil_hard_coal,0)+coalesce(fossil_gas,0)+coalesce(fossil_oil,0)+coalesce("fossil_coal-derived_gas",0)+coalesce(fossil_oil_shale,0)+coalesce(fossil_peat,0)) fossil,
 avg(coalesce("hydro_run-of-river_and_pondage",0)+coalesce(hydro_water_reservoir,0)) hydro,
 avg(coalesce(wind_onshore,0)+coalesce(wind_offshore,0)) wind, avg(solar) solar,
 avg(coalesce(biomass,0)+coalesce(geothermal,0)+coalesce(other_renewable,0)+coalesce(waste,0)) other_res
from entsoe.query_generation where $__timeFilter(index) and country in ('DE_LU','AT','BE','CH','CZ','DK','ES','FR','HU','IT','NL','PL','PT','SE','NO') group by 1,2) t group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Average net generation in the 15 zones, grouped by technology (pumped storage excluded).

panels.title: Day-ahead prices

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), country as metric, avg(value) as "price" from entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices
where $__timeFilter(index) and country in ($prices) group by 1,2 order by 1,2

panels.description: Day-ahead auction price in EUR/MWh for the zones chosen in the variable 'price zones' (hourly, 15 min since Oct 2025).

panels.title: Average day-ahead price per zone

targets.rawSql:
select country as zone, avg(value) as "EUR/MWh" from entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices
where $__timeFilter(index) and country in ('DE_LU','AT','BE','CH','CZ','DK','ES','FR','HU','IT','NL','PL','PT','SE','NO', 'DK_1','DK_2','SE_3','SE_4','NO_2','FI','GR','RO','BG','SI','SK','HR','EE','LT','LV','IE_SEM') group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.description: Mean day-ahead price over the selected time range for most European zones; shows the price level difference between regions.

panels.title: Large power plants (ENTSO-E power system data)

targets.rawSql: select lat, lon, capacity, name, country, energy_source from entsoe.powersystemdata where lat is not null and lon is not null and energy_source in ('Nuclear')
select lat, lon, capacity, name, country, energy_source from entsoe.powersystemdata where lat is not null and lon is not null and energy_source in ('Lignite')
select lat, lon, capacity, name, country, energy_source from entsoe.powersystemdata where lat is not null and lon is not null and energy_source in ('Hard coal')
select lat, lon, capacity, name, country, energy_source from entsoe.powersystemdata where lat is not null and lon is not null and energy_source in ('Natural gas')
select lat, lon, capacity, name, country, energy_source from entsoe.powersystemdata where lat is not null and lon is not null and energy_source in ('Hydro')

select lat, lon, capacity, name, country, energy_source from entsoe.powersystemdata where lat is not null and lon is not null and (energy_source is null or energy_source not in ('Nuclear','Lignite','Hard coal','Natural gas','Hydro'))

panels.description: Plants from the ENTSO-E power system data (table powersystemdata), marker size = capacity in MW, colour = energy source.

panels.title: Net cross-border flows of DE_LU

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg("de_lu-at" - "at-de_lu") as "AT", avg("de_lu-be" - "be-de_lu") as "BE", avg("de_lu-ch" - "ch-de_lu") as "CH", avg("de_lu-cz" - "cz-de_lu") as "CZ", avg("de_lu-dk_1" - "dk_1-de_lu") as "DK_1", avg("de_lu-dk_2" - "dk_2-de_lu") as "DK_2", avg("de_lu-fr" - "fr-de_lu") as "FR", avg("de_lu-nl" - "nl-de_lu") as "NL", avg("de_lu-no_2" - "no_2-de_lu") as "NO_2", avg("de_lu-pl" - "pl-de_lu") as "PL", avg("de_lu-se_4" - "se_4-de_lu") as "SE_4" from entsoe.query_crossborder_flows where $__timeFilter(index) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Net physical flow of the German-Luxembourg zone to each neighbour (flow DE_LU->X minus flow X->DE_LU). Positive = export, negative = import.

panels.title: Average load

targets.rawSql: select avg(actual_load) as v from entsoe.query_load where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country'

panels.description: Mean actual load in the time range.

panels.title: Average price

targets.rawSql: select avg(value) as v from entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country'

panels.description: Mean day-ahead price (EUR/MWh) in the time range.

panels.title: Negative price hours share

targets.rawSql: select avg((value < 0)::int)*100 as v from entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country'

panels.description: Share of price intervals with a negative day-ahead price.

panels.title: Renewable share of generation

targets.rawSql: select 100*sum(coalesce("biomass",0)+coalesce("geothermal",0)+coalesce("other_renewable",0)+coalesce("hydro_run-of-river_and_pondage",0)+coalesce("hydro_water_reservoir",0)+coalesce("solar",0)+coalesce("wind_onshore",0)+coalesce("wind_offshore",0)+coalesce("marine",0))/nullif(sum(coalesce("nuclear",0)+coalesce("fossil_brown_coal/lignite",0)+coalesce("fossil_hard_coal",0)+coalesce("fossil_coal-derived_gas",0)+coalesce("fossil_gas",0)+coalesce("fossil_oil",0)+coalesce("fossil_oil_shale",0)+coalesce("fossil_peat",0)+coalesce("waste",0)+coalesce("biomass",0)+coalesce("geothermal",0)+coalesce("other_renewable",0)+coalesce("hydro_run-of-river_and_pondage",0)+coalesce("hydro_water_reservoir",0)+coalesce("marine",0)+coalesce("wind_offshore",0)+coalesce("wind_onshore",0)+coalesce("solar",0)+coalesce("other",0)),0) as v from entsoe.query_generation where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country'

panels.description: Biomass, geothermal, other renewable, hydro (without pumped storage), solar, wind and marine as share of net generation.

panels.title: Wind + solar share of load

targets.rawSql: select 100*sum(g.v)/nullif(sum(l.v),0) as v from (select index, coalesce(solar,0)+coalesce(wind_onshore,0)+coalesce(wind_offshore,0) v from entsoe.query_generation where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country') g join (select index, actual_load v from entsoe.query_load where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country') l using(index)

panels.description: Energy from wind and solar divided by the actual load of the same intervals.

panels.title: Peak load

targets.rawSql: select max(actual_load) as v from entsoe.query_load where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country'

panels.description: Highest actual load in the time range.

panels.title: Load: actual vs day-ahead forecast

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(actual_load) as "actual load" from entsoe.query_load where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1 order by 1
select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(forecasted_load) as "forecast" from entsoe.query_load_forecast where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Actual total load and the TSO day-ahead forecast.

panels.title: Load forecast error

targets.rawSql:
select l.time, l.v - f.v as "actual - forecast (MW)" from
(select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(actual_load) v from entsoe.query_load where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1) l
join (select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(forecasted_load) v from entsoe.query_load_forecast where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1) f using(time) order by 1

panels.description: Forecast error of the day-ahead load forecast: positive = more consumption than forecast.

panels.title: Generation mix

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg("nuclear") as "nuclear", avg("fossil_brown_coal/lignite") as "lignite", avg("fossil_hard_coal") as "hard coal", avg("fossil_coal-derived_gas") as "coal-derived gas", avg("fossil_gas") as "gas", avg("fossil_oil") as "oil", avg("fossil_oil_shale") as "oil shale", avg("fossil_peat") as "peat", avg("waste") as "waste", avg("biomass") as "biomass", avg("geothermal") as "geothermal", avg("other_renewable") as "other renewable", avg("hydro_run-of-river_and_pondage") as "hydro run-of-river", avg("hydro_water_reservoir") as "hydro reservoir", avg("hydro_pumped_storage") as "hydro pumped storage", avg("energy_storage") as "energy storage", avg("marine") as "marine", avg("wind_offshore") as "wind offshore", avg("wind_onshore") as "wind onshore", avg("solar") as "solar", avg("other") as "other" from entsoe.query_generation where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Net generation per production type (average over the interval). Technologies the zone does not report stay empty. Pumped storage is negative while pumping.

panels.title: Generation share (percent)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg("nuclear") as "nuclear", avg("fossil_brown_coal/lignite") as "lignite", avg("fossil_hard_coal") as "hard coal", avg("fossil_coal-derived_gas") as "coal-derived gas", avg("fossil_gas") as "gas", avg("fossil_oil") as "oil", avg("fossil_oil_shale") as "oil shale", avg("fossil_peat") as "peat", avg("waste") as "waste", avg("biomass") as "biomass", avg("geothermal") as "geothermal", avg("other_renewable") as "other renewable", avg("hydro_run-of-river_and_pondage") as "hydro run-of-river", avg("hydro_water_reservoir") as "hydro reservoir", avg("hydro_pumped_storage") as "hydro pumped storage", avg("energy_storage") as "energy storage", avg("marine") as "marine", avg("wind_offshore") as "wind offshore", avg("wind_onshore") as "wind onshore", avg("solar") as "solar", avg("other") as "other" from entsoe.query_generation where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Same data as above, normalised to 100 % to show the shares of each technology.

panels.title: Day-ahead price and residual load

targets.rawSql:
select l.time, l.v - coalesce(g.v,0) as "residual load (MW)", p.v as "day-ahead price (EUR/MWh)" from
(select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(actual_load) v from entsoe.query_load where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1) l
left join (select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(coalesce(solar,0)+coalesce(wind_onshore,0)+coalesce(wind_offshore,0)) v from entsoe.query_generation where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1) g using(time)
left join (select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(value) v from entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1) p using(time)
order by 1

panels.description: Residual load = actual load - wind - solar (left axis, MW) against the day-ahead price (right axis, EUR/MWh). High residual load typically coincides with high prices.

panels.title: Wind and solar: day-ahead forecast vs actual

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(solar) as "solar actual", avg(coalesce(wind_onshore,0)+coalesce(wind_offshore,0)) as "wind actual" from entsoe.query_generation where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1 order by 1

select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(solar) as "solar forecast", avg(coalesce(wind_onshore,0)+coalesce(wind_offshore,0)) as "wind forecast" from entsoe.query_wind_and_solar_forecast where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Day-ahead forecast of wind (onshore + offshore) and solar generation against the realised values.

panels.title: Total generation: actual vs day-ahead forecast

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(coalesce("nuclear",0)+coalesce("fossil_brown_coal/lignite",0)+coalesce("fossil_hard_coal",0)+coalesce("fossil_coal-derived_gas",0)+coalesce("fossil_gas",0)+coalesce("fossil_oil",0)+coalesce("fossil_oil_shale",0)+coalesce("fossil_peat",0)+coalesce("waste",0)+coalesce("biomass",0)+coalesce("geothermal",0)+coalesce("other_renewable",0)+coalesce("hydro_run-of-river_and_pondage",0)+coalesce("hydro_water_reservoir",0)+coalesce("marine",0)+coalesce("wind_offshore",0)+coalesce("wind_onshore",0)+coalesce("solar",0)+coalesce("other",0)) as "actual generation (without storage)" from entsoe.query_generation where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1 order by 1

select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(actual_aggregated) as "day-ahead generation forecast" from entsoe.query_generation_forecast where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$country' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Sum of the net generation per type against the day-ahead total generation forecast (column actual_aggregated of query_generation_forecast; scheduled_* columns are empty in the data).

panels.title: Capacity factors of wind and solar

targets.rawSql:
with cap as (select * from entsoe.query_installed_generation_capacity where country='$country' order by index desc limit 1)
select $__timeGroupAlias(g.index,$__interval), 100*avg(g.solar)/nullif(max(c.solar),0) as "solar", 100*avg(g.wind_onshore)/nullif(max(c.wind_onshore),0) as "wind onshore",
 100*avg(g.wind_offshore)/nullif(max(c.wind_offshore),0) as "wind offshore"
from entsoe.query_generation g, cap c where $__timeFilter(g.index) and g.country='$country' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Generation divided by the most recent annual installed capacity of the zone (query_installed_generation_capacity).

panels.title: Installed generation capacity

targets.rawSql:
select k as technology, v as "MW" from (select * from entsoe.query_installed_generation_capacity where country='$country' order by index desc limit 1) c,
lateral (values ('nuclear', "nuclear"), ('lignite', "fossil_brown_coal/lignite"), ('hard coal', "fossil_hard_coal"), ('coal-derived gas', "fossil_coal-derived_gas"), ('gas', "fossil_gas"), ('oil', "fossil_oil"), ('oil shale', "fossil_oil_shale"), ('peat', "fossil_peat"), ('waste', "waste"), ('biomass', "biomass"), ('geothermal', "geothermal"), ('other renewable', "other_renewable"), ('hydro run-of-river', "hydro_run-of-river_and_pondage"), ('hydro reservoir', "hydro_water_reservoir"), ('hydro pumped storage', "hydro_pumped_storage"), ('energy storage', "energy_storage"), ('marine', "marine"), ('wind offshore', "wind_offshore"), ('wind onshore', "wind_onshore"), ('solar', "solar"), ('other', "other")) x(k,v) where v is not null and v > 0 order by v desc

panels.description: Installed net generating capacity per production type, latest year available for the zone (published once per year).

panels.title: Installed capacity over the years

targets.rawSql: select index as time, "nuclear" as "nuclear", "fossil_brown_coal/lignite" as "lignite", "fossil_hard_coal" as "hard coal", "fossil_gas" as "gas", "biomass" as "biomass", "hydro_run-of-river_and_pondage" as "hydro run-of-river", "hydro_water_reservoir" as "hydro reservoir", "hydro_pumped_storage" as "hydro pumped storage", "wind_offshore" as "wind offshore", "wind_onshore" as "wind onshore", "solar" as "solar" from entsoe.query_installed_generation_capacity where country='$country' order by 1

panels.description: Annual installed capacity, all years in the table (independent of the dashboard time range).

panels.title: Flow on border $border

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg("$border") as "$border" from entsoe.query_crossborder_flows where $__timeFilter(index) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Physical flow in MW from the first to the second zone of the selected border.

panels.title: Price spread on border $border

targets.rawSql:
select a.time, a.v as "price (from zone)", b.v as "price (to zone)", b.v - a.v as "spread (to - from)" from
(select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(value) v from entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices where $__timeFilter(index) and country = upper(split_part('$border','-',1)) group by 1) a
join (select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), avg(value) v from entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices where $__timeFilter(index) and country = upper(split_part('$border','-',2)) group by 1) b using(time) order by 1

panels.description: Day-ahead prices of the two zones of the border (zone code = border part in upper case) and their difference. Flows normally go from the cheap to the expensive zone. Borders involving DE_AT_LU or Italian sub-zones may return nothing.

panels.title: Largest units: mean output in $plant_country

targets.rawSql:
select name, avg(value) as "MW" from entsoe.query_per_plant where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$plant_country'
group by name order by 2 desc limit 20

panels.description: Mean actual generation of the 20 largest units (generation per unit data, > 100 MW units only) in the chosen area and time range.

panels.title: Top 10 units: output in $plant_country

targets.rawSql:
with top as (select name from entsoe.query_per_plant where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$plant_country' group by name order by avg(value) desc limit 10)
select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), name as metric, avg(value) as "MW" from entsoe.query_per_plant where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$plant_country' and name in (select name from top)
group by 1,2 order by 1,2

panels.description: Output of the 10 units with the highest mean generation.

panels.title: Generation per unit by type in $plant_country

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), type as metric, sum(value) as "MW" from entsoe.query_per_plant
where $__timeFilter(index) and country='$plant_country' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

panels.description: Sum of the reporting units per production type. Only units above 100 MW report, so this is not the full country generation.
